message.title: Message
message.description: Result summary — "Submission is complete." when nothing is missing, or "N missing item(s) found." when items are missing; or the error detail if it failed.

missingCount.title: Missing Item Count
missingCount.description: The number of missing or incomplete requirements found on the submission. 0 means the submission is complete.

success.title: Success
success.description: True if validation completed and the submission was updated; false if it failed.
